title: HateRephrase: Zero- and Few-Shot Reduction of Hate Intensity in Online Posts using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hate intensity reduction (HIR) in LLM-rephrased online posts using toxicity scores from Google Jigsaw's Perspective API, combined with human annotations for hate reduction, hallucination, and semantic relevance.
Qualitative case studies and failure analyses specifically examining how LLMs detect, isolate, and rephrase hate speech targeted at the Islamic religion and Muslims.
